en.name: Applesauce, commercial
en.summary: Commercial applesauce in jars, cans or pouches keeps 12–18 months from purchase in the cupboard. Once opened it is an ordinary refrigerated fruit purée: 7–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: An unopened jar, can or pouch keeps 12–18 months from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard, or to the printed date if that comes first. Apples are acidic enough to count as a high-acid food, which is why a sealed jar is stable at room temperature — but the stability belongs to the seal and the heat processing, not to the fruit alone. Keep jars out of sunlight, which fades the colour, and discard without tasting any jar with a domed lid, a can that is bulging or rusted, or a pouch that has inflated.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within 7–10 days. A jar can go back in the fridge with its own lid; a can should not — transfer the contents to a clean covered container. Use a clean spoon each time, because applesauce is sweet, moist and easy to contaminate, and a jar that has been dipped into with a used spoon grows mould at the surface long before its time. Sugar-free versions, with nothing but acid protecting them, tend to reach the shorter end of that window.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for applesauce here, so none is offered — but it freezes well and is safe indefinitely at −18 °C (0 °F). If you have opened a large jar, freezing the surplus in small portions or an ice cube tray is far more sensible than trying to stretch the fridge window; it thaws a little looser and perfectly good for cooking, baking or spooning over porridge.
en.thawing: Thaw overnight in the fridge and stir before serving. Never thaw on the counter, and use thawed applesauce within a couple of days.
spoilage: Mould at the surface or under the rim of the lid — discard the jar rather than spooning it off.
A fermented, alcoholic or fizzy quality, which means yeasts have got going.
A domed lid, a bulging can, or a jar that hisses or spurts when opened.
A sour, sharply off smell rather than a clean apple one.
tips: Use a clean dry spoon every time; contamination is what usually ends a jar.
Buy small jars or pouches if you only use it occasionally.
Freeze the surplus from a large jar in portions on the day you open it.
Never store an opened can in the fridge; decant it.

faq.q: How long does applesauce last once opened?
faq.a: 7–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Unopened, 12–18 months from purchase in the cupboard.
No timeline is published here, but it freezes well and is safe indefinitely at −18 °C. Freeze the surplus in small portions.

faq.q: Why did my applesauce go fizzy?
faq.a: Yeasts have begun fermenting the sugars, usually after contamination from a used spoon. Throw it out.

zh.name: 市售蘋果泥
zh.summary: 市售的玻璃罐、罐頭或軟包裝蘋果泥，從購買日起算放櫥櫃可放 12～18 個月。開封後它就是一般的冷藏水果泥：4 °C 以下 7～10 天。
zh.pantry: 未開封的玻璃罐、罐頭或軟包，從購買日起算放陰涼避光的櫥櫃 12～18 個月，若標示日期更早則以標示為準。蘋果的酸度足以歸類為高酸性食品，這是密封罐能常溫穩定的原因——但那份穩定屬於密封與加熱殺菌，不是水果本身。罐子避免日曬（會褪色）；瓶蓋鼓起、罐身脹或生鏽、軟包膨起的，請直接丟棄，不要試吃。
zh.fridge: 開封後放 4 °C 以下，7～10 天內用完。玻璃罐可以蓋回自己的蓋子冰；罐頭不行——請把內容物移到乾淨的加蓋容器。每次都用乾淨湯匙，因為蘋果泥又甜又濕、很容易被污染，一罐被用過的湯匙挖過，遠早於期限就會從表面長霉。無糖版本只靠酸度保護，通常會落在這個區間的短邊。
zh.freezer: 這裡沒有給蘋果泥的冷凍期限，所以本頁不提供——但它很耐凍，在 −18 °C 下安全性是無限期的。如果你開了一大罐，把多的分成小份或倒進製冰盒冷凍，遠比硬撐冷藏期限合理；解凍後質地會稍稀，拿來入菜、烘焙或淋在粥上都很好。
zh.thawing: 冷藏隔夜解凍，食用前攪拌均勻。不要放室溫退冰，解凍後兩三天內用完。
spoilage: 表面或瓶蓋內緣長霉——整罐丟棄，不要只把霉舀掉。
出現發酵味、酒精味或氣泡感，代表酵母開始作用。
瓶蓋鼓起、罐頭脹罐，或打開時有洩氣聲、噴汁。
聞起來發酸、有明顯異味，而不是乾淨的蘋果香。
tips: 每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙；污染才是一罐蘋果泥最常見的結局。
偶爾才用就買小罐或小包裝。
開大罐的當天就把多的分份冷凍。
開過的罐頭絕不要整罐冰，請倒出來。

faq.q: 蘋果泥開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下 7～10 天。未開封放櫥櫃則是從購買日起算 12～18 個月。
這裡沒有公布的期限，但它很耐凍，−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的。多的請分小份冷凍。

faq.q: 蘋果泥為什麼變得有氣泡？
faq.a: 酵母開始把糖分發酵了，通常是被用過的湯匙污染所致。請丟掉。
